Accounting documents and conclusions produced with this skill must be verified by a qualified professional before any official use. Curated by Skill Harbor: the forensic accounting skill of GAJETOso/financeskills, written from the seat of a forensic accountant and certified fraud examiner. Use it for litigation support or a high-stakes internal investigation when something does not add up: suspicious transactions, missing funds, embezzlement checks, laundering detection, shell company questions or whistleblower claims. The assessment fixes the investigation context (legal case or internal, the specific suspicion, the period in question) and the access and confidentiality terms (bank statements, emails, ERP logs, and who is authorized to see the findings, privileged or not). The skill is honest about a hard limit: generic fetching and scraping cannot access secure banking portals or private ERP environments, so evidence must arrive as static files such as CSV exports or PDF statements, and no transaction is claimed as verified without raw source data.
